newsitem.title: USA: Deregulation good for US securities industry -- NASD.
newsitem.headline: Deregulation good for US securities industry -- NASD.

text.p: Frank Zarb, chief of the National Association of Securities Dealers, said on Thursday that while financial degregulation is good for the securities industry, investor protections must not be lost in the process.

"As we deregulate, which I think is a great idea ... we can't let the efficiencies of the deregulating process overrule our natural instinct," Zarb said. "We're very protective of the investor," he added.
Zarb, who is president and chief executive officer of the group, was speaking to a NASD Regulation spring securities conference.
Treasury Secretary Richard Rubin unveiled on Wednesday White House proposals to modernize the nation's bank regulation laws.

Zarb expressed concern on the overall question of deregulaton, warning against the possibility that "in our eagerness to create a contemporary financial structure, we relax some of the attention that we pay to the necessary oversight required."
